title: Follow-Up Thank-You Backlog
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:impact channel=* thank_you_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(thank_you_state!="sent",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by channel
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending thank-you notes backlog by channel for follow-up operations.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside follow-up operations.
implementation: Mark each `community:impact` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `channel`.
visualization: Table of channel with pending thank-you notes counts.
grandmaExplanation: It frames where unfinished thank-you notes are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in follow-up operations.
